Is it really free?
Yes. Every game on the site is free to play, and there is nothing to buy. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need to make an account?
No. There is no account, no sign-up and no newsletter. You open a game and play.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. The games run in your browser and start instantly, with no download and no installs.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Yes, for many games. Lots of them are made for touch and are collected in the Mobile category, and games built for a wide screen will ask you to turn the phone sideways. A few older games need a keyboard and mouse, and their page says so.
Is it safe for my kids?
The site accepts family-friendly games only, with no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are in the Kids category.
Will my progress and favourites be saved?

Yes, but only in your own browser. Your recently played games, favourites, light or dark choice and the saves of most games stay on your device and never leave it. If you clear your browser data or play in private mode, they are lost.
A game will not load. What can I do?
If a game fails to start, try reloading the page first. If it still does not work, email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com with the name of the game and we will look into it.
Where do the games come from?

Six games are made by Door 404, the studio behind the site. The rest are licensed from the distribution networks Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix, plus 22 games sent in directly by independent developers. We never copy games from other portals.
How do I submit my own game?
Send it at https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/. It is free and non-exclusive, and a real person plays every submission. Accepted games get their own page that credits you and links back to you.
How do I get my game removed?
Email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and we will take it down. Your game stays hosted on your own server, and you can ask for removal at any time.
Can I embed a game on my own website?

You can embed the games made by Door 404. Each has an "Embed this game" box with ready-made code on its page. Games from other developers are not ours to licence, so we cannot offer them for embedding.
How do I reach a real person?
Email contact@ilovewebgames.com. The site is run by Door 404, an escape room and game studio from Novi Sad, Serbia.
